added: Do you love babies or toddlers but are you either too young, not ready, or unable to have children of your own? Do you want a "parenting simulation" that feels real and is also fun? If this applies to you, then you should consider a reborn doll or reborn toddler. Reborn dolls are dolls that are made professionally to look like real babies or toddlers. They can be expensive to buy and care for, but it is all worth it in the end.
[[Category:Toys]]
== Steps ==

#Make sure you have the money to buy your reborn. Reborn dolls are not cheap. Be prepared to spend over $100 or $200 on your doll and its accessories.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 1 Version 5.jpg|center]]
#*You can get a reborn with the main body as cotton in for a cheaper price, if this suits your budget.

#Prepare for your reborn. Make sure you have everything set up just like you would if you were preparing to bring home a newborn. Make sure you have researched what supplies you might need, before bringing home your reborn doll.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 2 Version 5.jpg|center]]

#*Buy the essentials such as clothes, blankets, diapers, bottles, pacifiers, a deluxe stroller, a car seat, reborn doll milk formula [this is usually fabric softener or glue and water], baby wipes, and toddler toys. Do not feel the need to buy overpriced baby items. You can purchase items through the internet or in store.

#Unbox your reborn. When the doll arrives, pick out a name and fill out the birth certificate. If the box does not contain a birth certificate, you can print one off of the Internet.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 3 Version 5.jpg|center]]
#*Always be sure to take some photos with your reborn.

#Care for your reborn. Make sure you remember to change the baby, to make sure they are clean after their long trip. Perhaps you should prepare a warm bottle of milk for them, or cover them up in a warm blanket to take a nice long nap. Whatever you choose, be prepared to repeat it every day to create your daily reborn mommy routine.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 4 Version 5.jpg|center]]

#* You can also spend some time holding the reborn or child and sitting with them, so that you can become confident and comfortable with your reborn doll. Make sure to always care for your doll just like you would a newborn.

#Create a schedule. If you want to take care of your baby or toddler seriously, set up a schedule for your reborn baby or toddler. Your schedule should include feeding times, diaper changing times, nap times and play times. or tummy times. Sometimes if you are busy during the day then have a friend or boyfriend to help you look after or take care of your reborn toddler[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 5 Version 5.jpg|center]]

#Introduce your reborn baby or toddler to friends and family. You should do this when you are comfortable doing so. You might also be able to join communities or meet new friends with your new reborn baby or toddler.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 6 Version 5.jpg|center]]
#*If people come up to you and say, “Is that your baby or toddler?”, just say "Yes, this is my reborn baby or toddler". There is nothing wrong with being proud of your new baby or toddler.
#*If you want to have the doll all to yourself, that's fine, too, just be a good mom to your baby and always take care of it.

#Take your baby out for a stroll. Walk through the neighborhood with your deluxe baby stroller, give them a pacifier and make it all snuggled up in the stroller with a blanket or summer clothes if it is hot outside.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 7 Version 3.jpg|center]]

#* You could also carry a diaper bag. This could include extra diapers, a baby bottle, a changing blanket, and extra pacifiers & extra clothes [winter or summer]. You can use these items in the same way you would if you had a child or newborn or toddler.

#* Alternatively, place your reborn essentials into the bottom of your stroller in your diaper bag. Or, you can put them in your reborn’s booster seat in your car and take them for a ride around town or take them for long car rides until they fall asleep just like you would with a newborn or toddler.
== Video ==
{{Video:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll|}}
== Tips ==
*Choose a price range before you start looking at dolls so you do not overspend.
*When you take your reborn on a long trip make sure you have all the essentials, including diapers, bottle, toys, blanket, extra clothes, pacifiers, a stroller and a booster seat.
*If you can't get food out of their mouth, carefully use a toothpick.
*You can also buy reborn toddlers and children, though they are more expensive.
*Keep the doll away from small children under the age of 5.

*When you change a diaper, before you take the soiled diaper away, put the clean one underneath, then when you gently pull the diaper away, you will have a clean one to keep the baby or Toddler's bottom off of the table.
*Do not leave your baby doll anywhere alone.
*Take the right type of doll for you. Do not choose one that you do not really want.
*Keep a Schedule for you so you know what time to take care of your doll or toddler

*If you have a pet and you leave the house make sure your baby is in a room without any pets. They could chew on them and tear them apart piece by piece. If you keep the door closed, that helps a lot and keeps your pets from chewing them up.
*Never let them sit in the burning hot sun, they could melt like they are ice cream.
* But have your children ages 6 - 20 take care of your reborn toddler or baby if you are going somewhere without it.
*Do not feed them real food if they have a tube in their stomach, they could grow mold and easily destroy your reborn from the inside.
*If you have a silicone baby, you can give it a bath! Just make sure you are careful with it.
*Take care of it like it was your first baby or toddler.
== Warnings ==
*Be careful with your reborn, especially if you are handling food and water. Make sure you seal the bottles so they do not leak.
*Some babies have loose necks like real babies, so ensure you support the neck. Be aware of this before you buy them, so you make sure to be careful.
*Do not actually put lotion or products on them. You have a special and expensive doll, so be careful with it.
== Things You'll Need ==
*Reborn baby doll
*Comb or brush
*Baby items
*Baby toys
*Clothing
*Diapers
*[Deluxe] Stroller
*Bedding for the crib
*Blankets
*A Sleepy Time bouncer
*A White noise machine
*a Lullaby Machine
*Nursery room
*Extra Clothes
*Crib/playpen
*Diaper bag
*Pacifiers
*Fake milk/food
*Baby bottle
*Booster seat
*Pacifier Clip
*Extra Pacifiers

added: Do you love babies or toddlers but are you either too young, not ready, or unable to have children of your own? Do you want a "parenting simulation" that feels real and is also fun? If this applies to you, then you should consider a reborn doll or reborn toddler. Reborn dolls are dolls that are made professionally to look like real babies or toddlers. They can be expensive to buy and care for, but it is all worth it in the end.
[[Category:Baby and Newborn Dolls]]
== Steps ==
#Make sure you have the money to buy your reborn. Reborn dolls are not cheap. Be prepared to spend over $100.00 or $200.00 on your doll and its accessories.
#*You can get a reborn with the main body as cotton in for a cheaper price, if this suits your budget.

#Prepare for your reborn. Make sure you have everything set up just like you would if you were preparing to bring home a newborn. Make sure you have researched what supplies you might need, before bringing home your reborn doll.

#*Buy the essentials such as clothes, blankets, diapers, bottles, pacifiers, a deluxe stroller, a car seat, reborn doll milk formula [this is usually fabric softener or glue and water], baby wipes, and toddler toys. Do not feel the need to buy overpriced baby items. You can purchase items through the internet or in store.

#Unbox your reborn. When the doll arrives, pick out a name and fill out the birth certificate. If the box does not contain a birth certificate, you can print one off of the Internet. [[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 2 Version 4.jpg|center]]
#*Always be sure to take some photos with your reborn.

#Care for your reborn. Make sure you remember to change the baby, to make sure they are clean after their long trip. Perhaps you should prepare a warm bottle of milk for them, or cover them up in a warm blanket to take a nice long nap. Whatever you choose, be prepared to repeat it every day to create your daily reborn mommy routine. [[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 3 Version 4.jpg|center]]

#* You can also spend some time holding the reborn or child and sitting with him or her, so that you can become confident and comfortable with your reborn doll. Make sure to always care for your doll just like you would a newborn.

#Create a schedule. If you want to take care of your baby or toddler seriously, set up a schedule for your reborn baby or toddler. Your schedule should include feeding times, diaper changing times, nap times and play times. or tummy times. Sometimes if you are busy during the day then have a friend or boyfriend to help you look after or take care of your reborn toddler [[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 4 Version 4.jpg|center]]

#Introduce your reborn baby or toddler to friends and family. You should do this when you are comfortable doing so. You might also be able to join communities or meet new friends with your new reborn baby or toddler. [[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 5 Version 4.jpg|center]]
#*If people come up to you and say “Is that your toddler?”, just say "Yes, this is my reborn baby or toddler". There is nothing wrong with being proud of your new baby or toddler.
#*If you want to have the doll all to yourself, that's fine, too, just be a good mom to your baby and always take care of it.

#Take your baby out for a stroll. Walk through the neighborhood with your deluxe baby stroller, give them a pacifier and make it all snuggled up in the stroller with a blanket or summer clothes if it is hot outside. [[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 6 Version 4.jpg|center]]

#* You could also carry a diaper bag. This could include extra diapers, a baby bottle, a changing blanket, and extra pacifiers & extra clothes [winter or summer]. You can use these items in the same way you would if you had a child or newborn or toddler.

#* Alternatively, place your reborn essentials into the bottom of your stroller in your diaper bag. Or, you can put them in your reborn’s booster seat in your car and take them for a ride around town or take them for long car rides until they fall asleep just like you would with a newborn or toddler.
== Video ==
{{Video:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll|}}
== Tips ==
*Choose a price range before you start looking at dolls so you do not overspend.
*If you can't get food out of their mouth, carefully use a toothpick.
*When you take your reborn on a long trip make sure you have all the essentials, including diapers, bottle, toys, blanket, extra clothes, pacifiers, a stroller and a booster seat.
*You can also buy reborn toddlers and children, though they are more expensive.

*When you change a diaper, before you take the soiled diaper away, put the clean one underneath, then when you gently pull the diaper away, you will have a clean one to keep the baby or Toddler's bottom off of the table.
*Do not leave your baby doll anywhere alone.
*Keep a Schedule for you so you know what time to take care of your doll or toddler
*Take the right type of doll for you. Do not choose one that you do not really want.

*If you have a pet and you leave the house make sure your baby is in a room without any pets. They could chew on them and tear them apart piece by piece. If you keep the door closed, that helps a lot and keeps your pets from chewing them up.
*Take care of it like it was your first baby or toddler.
*Do not feed them real food if they have a tube in their stomach, they could grow mold and easily destroy your reborn from the inside.
*Never let them sit in the burning hot sun, they could melt like they are ice cream.
*If you have a silicone baby, you can give it a bath! Just make sure you are careful with it.
*Keep the doll away from small children under the age of 5.
* But have your children ages 6 - 20 take care of your reborn toddler or baby if you are going somewhere without it.
== Warnings ==
*Be careful with your reborn, especially if you are handling food and water. Make sure you seal the bottles so they do not leak.
*Some babies have loose necks like real babies, so ensure you support the neck. Be aware of this before you buy them, so you make sure to be careful.
*Do not actually put lotion or products on them. You have a special and expensive doll, so be careful with it.
== Things You'll Need ==
*Reborn baby doll
*Comb or brush
*Baby items
*Baby toys
*Clothing
*Diapers
*[Deluxe] Stroller
*Bedding for the crib
*Blankets
*A Sleepy Time bouncer
*A White noise machine
*a Lullaby Machine
*Nursery room
*Extra Clothes
*Crib/playpen
*Diaper bag
*Pacifiers
*Fake milk/food
*Baby bottle
*Booster seat
*Pacifier Clip
*Extra Pacifiers
== Related wikiHows ==
*[[Reborn a Doll]]
*[[Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll]]

If this applies to you then you should consider a reborn doll. Reborn dolls are dolls that are made professionally to look like real babies. They can be expensive, but it is all worth it.

#Prepare for your reborn as you would a real baby. Make sure you are prepared before you buy your reborn doll, just like a real baby.[[Image: Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 2 Version 4.jpg|center]]

#*Buy real clothes or order them off the Internet. Purchase blankets, diapers, bottles, pacifiers, blankets, stroller, car seat (either infant or toddler), fake formula (this can be made with fabric softener or glue and water, it's up to you) wipes, and toys, for example. Do not feel the need to buy overpriced items. As real as your reborn is to you, your reborn is a doll, a toy to practice with for when you are grown up.

#*Plan for what doll you want. Do you want a girl or a boy? Do you care if the main body is cotton in exchange for a cheaper price? As well, reborn dolls are not cheap. Be prepared to spend over $100.
#Unbox your baby! When he (or she) arrives, pick out a name and fill out the birth certificate (If the box does not contain a birth certificate, you can print one off the internet). Be sure to
take some photos with your baby.

#Care for your baby. Choose whether you want to change the baby, to make sure they are clean after their long trip. Perhaps you should prepare a bottle for them, or cover them up in a warm blanket to take a nice long nap. Whatever you choose, be prepared to repeat it every day. Spend some time holding the reborn and sitting with him or her, as this will make you feel more confident and comfortable with your doll.[[Image: Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 3 Version 4.jpg|center]]

Take your baby out of the box, and remove their clothing to observe the doll and see if there are any marks or scratches on them. Then, redress them. Take some photos with your baby.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 2 Version 3.jpg|center]]

#Take your baby on a walk through the neighborhood in a stroller with a diaper in the under pocket of the stroller also you will feel confident enough to do it. It'll make you feel like a real mother to a real child. If you want, instead you can place him/her into a padded basket with a blanket.[[Image:Take Care of a Reborn Baby Doll Step 6 Version 3.jpg|center]]

*When you take your reborn on a long trip make sure you have all the essentials, for example diapers, bottle, toys, blanket, extra clothes, pacifiers, strollers, car seats both toddler or infant, etc.
*Never let them sit in the burning hot sun because they could melt.

added: # Order the doll. You can usually get one off of eBay or Amazon. If  you search Google you may find some other site specifically devoted to them.
# Buy the specific clothing from the sites that the doll came from or in a pinch, just buy  clothing from retail store or if you want to be fancy go to kohls or something like that
# Buy baby doll things such as, Cribs, Highchair (depending on what size doll you get), blankets, changing table. and toys(if you want).
# If you want, you can even buy a pack of diapers or pull-ups for your doll. You will only need one pack seeing as these dolls don't really have bladders
# Buy like three real bottles and seal them yourself and put formula in them or something else you want the baby to drink. You can get some from the sites that the dolls come from.
# After you get the doll you will need to treat it like a real baby. Hold it, change it, put it down for naps, feed it, and everything you would do for a real baby.
*don't start buying things for the doll until you order it because things could change and you could get too excited!
*Don't leave the baby in the car because people think these are real and they call the cops.
*loving, motherly heart
